intro: Between late April and August 2026, ZCyberNews documented eight security incidents tagged under Check Point Research, spanning five high-severity and two critical findings. Handala Hack, JSCeal, and Silver Dragon were observed as distinct threat actors across affected regions including China, Europe, Global, Israel, and Mexico. Key vulnerabilities tracked were CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Targeted sectors included government, business services, consumer, critical infrastructure, and cryptocurrency. These reports collectively highlight the breadth of attack surfaces monitored by Check Point Research during this period.
